segments.title: February
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! February. The shortest month, and the most romantic. Our theme is Red Flags, Green Flags: Valentine's, Galentine's and Singles Awareness Day, and a studio that is very much a green flag.

segments.title: ₹1.83L
segments.text: So, the number. Our February target for Pop-up is 1.83 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent above last February. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 89,000 rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 80,600, comebacks 11,800, and everything else 1,800. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 48 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 562 leads, 146 trials, and 48 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 64,200 rupees, which is 35 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Love Bombing (The Healthy Kind)
segments.text: First up, Love Bombing, the healthy kind. Every member writes a love letter to a friend: two free classes. If the friend joins, they get fifteen per cent off and grip socks, and the member gets five extra days. The plan is 2 buyers at about 5,900, so 11,800 rupees.
segments.notes: Current members bringing a never-been friend.

segments.title: Blind Date (No Catfishing)
segments.text: Next, Blind Date, no catfishing. Two mystery classes for nine ninety-nine. The format and the trainer stay sealed until you walk in. Love it, and the whole fee comes off your first month. The plan is 3 buyers at about 5,900, so 17,700 rupees.

segments.title: It’s Not You, It’s Your Schedule
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, It's Not You, It's Your Schedule. They pick a relationship status: Exclusive is three months, Casual is a twelve-class pack, It's Complicated is one month with a free freeze. Fifteen per cent off whichever they choose. The plan is 2 buyers at about 5,900, so 11,800 rupees.

segments.title: Put a Ring On It
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Put a Ring On It. Renew for three months and get the ring, which is a mini-band, relax. Six months comes with a private, and annual members go on the Wall of Commitment. Say yes at the desk and the bell rings. The plan is 3 buyers at about 7,700, so 23,000 rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing in February (any expiry date).

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, blind-date envelopes at every desk, and the love letters go out to members. Week two, Galentine's and Valentine's weekend, with Partner Barre on Sunday the fourteenth. Week three, the Hate-Squat Hour for the singles, and every renewal hears Put a Ring On It. Week four, last call for lapsed members to pick their relationship status.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's February at Pop-up. 1.83 lakh rupees, four offers, and 48 buyers to welcome. Short month, long commitments. That's the dream.
